name: TankerTrackers
why: Fills the reserved tg_tanker_trackers slot. Tier 3 - real OSINT outfit not an institution.

name: UKMTO mirror (unofficial)
why: Carries group=ukmto so it can never corroborate UKMTO independently. Only live path to UKMTO advisories since both official URLs are CUT_BOT_BLOCKED.

name: Mornovosti (maritime news)
why: Adds Russian as a 5th source language beyond the en/fa/ar/he spec. Gemini handles ru so no capability issue.

name: Al Jazeera Arabic
why: group=al_jazeera - one newsroom with AJ English so the two cannot corroborate each other.

name: Sky News Arabia
why: Abu Dhabi based. Gulf editorial line. Separate group from aawsat but read the pair as one directional bloc on Iran.

name: Asharq Al-Awsat
why: VOLUME RISK - 300 items on first probe. General pan-Arab daily not a security wire. Needs a topic prefilter before Phase 6 or it dominates the cluster budget alone.

name: Al Manar
why: Hezbollah-owned party organ. Tier 3 - nominates never corroborates. First on the Lebanon front.

name: Ynet Hebrew
why: group=israeli_press - same newsroom as ynet English. FRESHNESS UNVERIFIED - probe returned an empty newest date on an RSS row; ynet English shows the identical blank in r4 with the same 30 items so this is a DATE_RE format miss not a stale feed. Phase 3 collector must parse ynet date format.

name: Maariv breaking news
why: Breaking-news-only feed - low noise good shape for a curator. group=israeli_press.

name: Al Arabiya
why: 403 = server answered and refused = block not bad path. ci4 falsified the header hypothesis so no collector-side fix exists. Gulf counterweight survives via aawsat + sky_news_arabia.

name: Al Mayadeen
why: Same 403 reasoning. Loss of the pro-resistance-axis early-framing source is absorbed by al_manar.

name: Israel Hayom
why: Same 403 reasoning. The only r5 cut with no substitute - no other right-leaning Israeli feed in the set.
